entities.summary: Michal Mertiňák is a retired professional tennis player from Slovakia. He turned professional in 1999, and has won six doubles titles in his career on the ATP Tour. He reached his career high doubles ranking of World No. 12 in February 2010. He played in the 2005 Davis Cup for Slovakia, who finished runner-up to Croatia. Mertiňák played two ties in the final, including losing the deciding fifth rubber to Mario Ančić. Michal Mertiňák was a athletes & competitors from Považská Bystrica (b. 1979-10-11, Považská Bystrica). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
